anchorMeaning: Fixed art-space group ground anchor derived from the approved 1024x576 mother reference after Doubao's 1.25x 1280x720 output scaling; not runtime collision calibration.

viewPlanning.basis: Single engineer body height, not total gun length; shallow right-facing engineering camera and horizontal group staging remain fixed.

idle.selectionReason: 4.167s calm interval with a measured near-match between source frames 19 and 119; preserves long-loop feel without the weaker whole-source seam.

run.selectionReason: One complete 2.000s in-place pushing gait cycle. Frames 70 and 118 are the strongest measured natural seam after confirming multiple cycles in the approved 5s source.

attack.selectionReason: Full wind-up, single discharge and recovery; retain every native source pose around flash and initial recoil, then step4 through smoke dissipation and recovery.

die.selectionReason: Full irreversible death action; retain native reserve-shell release and both separate falling phases, ending on the held final prone state without wrap.

interpolation.loopOutputRule: N source keys become 2N output frames with last-to-first seam interpolation.
interpolation.oneShotOutputRule: N source keys become 2N-1 output frames without last-to-first interpolation.
